Subject: SpryTech activation: invoice submission handshake & template checklist

Julia — great to be kicking off SpryTech's activation this week. Two quick asks so we can wire up billing cleanly on day one: 

1) Primary invoice channel: do you plan to use the vendor portal we provided, or will you submit invoices by email to billing@sprytech.com? If you email PDFs, does your system produce one PDF per invoice or multi-invoice batches?

2) PO linkage: how do you currently place the PO number on invoices (line-level, header, filename)? We need a consistent rule so our AP can auto-match.

3) Can you attach a sample invoice (redact any real $ amounts if needed) and your vendor onboarding form if you have one?

Goal: recommend portal-first for long-term reliability, but support email fallback during the first 30 days of go-live. If email fallback is needed, we'll ask for a subject token and filename convention to automate ingestion.

If you can send the sample + quick answers today, we can send you a short onboarding packet and DocuSign link to complete (one-time).

Thanks,
Priyom
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks, Priyom — quick answers below and attaching a redacted sample.

- Channel: We historically email billing@sprytech.com with a single PDF per invoice. We do have a portal but it's team-managed (not currently enabled for external partners).
- Filename: invoice_<invoice-number>_<date>.pdf (we can add PO if you need).
- PO placement: PO is typically in header under "Reference". Some older templates put PO on the first line item.
- Remittance: bank details on last page in remittance box; we can move to header if that helps.

Attached: vendor_invoice_sample.pdf (redacted)

If portal is preferred by you, we can talk to our ops team about enabling partner uploads; timeline ~2-3 weeks.

Best,
Julia Ramos

Short answer: portal-first, allow email fallback for the first 30 days but enforce strict ingestion rules during fallback. Please implement the checklist below before go-live: 

- Portal: enable partner uploads with SSO optional, but require per-file metadata entry: PO number (required), invoice date, invoice number.
- Email fallback (30 days only): subject must start with "RDW-SPRY-<account-id>", filename must include PO (invoice_<po>_<inv>.pdf). Any non-conforming email should trigger a manual queue and notification to vendor.
- Mapping: treat PO in header as canonical; if line-level PO conflicts, flag for ops review.
- Remittance: ask vendor to move remittance box to header to improve automated reconciliation (optional but strongly recommended).

I attach our standard vendor onboarding form and a short doc with filename/subject examples you can send to Julia. Also check with Security on SSO guest policy — do not open portal uploads without approval.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Operations — Redwood Inference

Julia — thanks for the quick info and the sample. Plan below so we're aligned for go-live: 

1) Portal-first: we'd prefer you upload invoices to the Redwood vendor portal. Vanessa is looping in Security for a short review; expected partner enablement ~2-3 weeks. We'll send SSO/guest instructions once cleared.

2) Email fallback (temporary): while portal is being enabled, please email invoices to billing@sprytech.com with the subject token and filename conventions below so our AP automation can match reliably: 
   - Subject: RDW-SPRY-98765
   - Filename: invoice_<PO>_<INVNUMBER>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (please include PO in filename)

3) PO mapping: we'll treat the header "Reference" field as canonical. If you can't move PO to header, ensure the filename contains the PO and we will match on filename as a fallback.

4) Onboarding packet: attaching the onboarding form and DocuSign link. Please complete the onboarding form and sign the partner addendum in DocuSign by EOD Friday 2027-10-22 to avoid delays.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef-activation
Onboarding form: attached (sprytech_onboarding_form_v2.pdf)

If you run into any blockers with your ops team enabling portal uploads, escalate to me and cc Vanessa. We'll support the 30-day email fallback but require filenames/subject token compliance to keep invoices flowing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting SpryTech live.

Priyom Das
